notes: Created from the 2026-10-19 HuggingFace discovery crawl. Benchmarks are the card's own published rows (vendor claims). architecture and task are inferred from the slug and param ratio; KV geometry, context length and quant sizes are not yet filled, hence status draft. KV basis: Growing term: 16 full_attention layers x 8 kv heads x 128 head_dim (5120/40) x 2 (K+V) x 2 bytes = 65,536 B/token. The other 48 layers are sliding_attention with a 4,096-token window, a fixed cost per sequence (48 x 8 x 128 x 4 x 4096 = 768 MiB) that does not grow with context; charging all 64 layers (naive worst case) would be 262,144 B/token. Counts from allenai/Olmo-3.1-32B-Instruct config.json layer_types. REVIEWED 2026-10-21: card confirms every claimed row. Card evaluation table lists all nine rows for Olmo 3.1 32B Instruct with matching values. RELEASE DATE CORRECTED 2026-10-21: was 2026, now 2025 per the HF repo creation date (2025-12-10). The wrong year made every recency multiplier a no-op for this record.
